what: LEGAL PRESSURE MAP. What is exerting pressure on the current system. Not a prediction.

statusClasses.OBSERVED: measured in this corpus or quoted from an enacted text this repository holds
statusClasses.EXPECTED: follows from an OBSERVED fact plus a stated legal or institutional mechanism

horizons.aHorizonIsNotAForecast: it says when an observable consequence could plausibly emerge, with no probability attached

signals.title: 2026 designated the Year of Artificial Intelligence; SDAIA issues guidelines to unify national effort
signals.observable_evidence: an official state announcement; no corpus observable follows from it directly
signals.possible_legal_consequence: increased institutional AI adoption across government, including justice bodies

signals.title: SDAIA opens public consultation on a draft Responsible AI policy via the Istitlaa platform
signals.observable_evidence: a named draft instrument under official consultation
signals.possible_legal_consequence: a binding or advisory AI policy instrument; if binding and breached, a regulatory rather than commercial forum would see it first

signals.title: SDAIA issues rules governing personal data protection licensing and accreditation
signals.observable_evidence: a licensing regime around the Personal Data Protection Law
signals.possible_legal_consequence: a compliance market and an enforcement channel; disputes would surface in a regulatory forum before a commercial one

signals.title: Personal Data Protection Law committees to impose penalties on confirmed violations
signals.observable_evidence: an operating penalty mechanism
signals.possible_legal_consequence: the first data-protection disputes with a decided record; NOT in this corpus, whose forum is commercial adjudication

signals.title: Law permitting non-Saudi ownership of real estate enters into force 22 January 2026
signals.observable_evidence: an instrument in force with a stated date
signals.possible_legal_consequence: new transaction volume, and eventually new dispute families; whether any of it reaches published commercial adjudication is unknown

signals.title: Labour Law amendments: 38 articles revised, 7 omitted, 2 added
signals.institution: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development
signals.observable_evidence: an amendment package in force; the Labour Law is cited only 12 times in this corpus, so its visibility here is minimal
signals.possible_legal_consequence: labour disputes are not the commercial forum's docket; observable uptake here is unlikely

signals.title: New Enforcement Law welcomed by the Minister of Justice
signals.observable_evidence: already carried as LSIG-0004 in the legal signal registry
signals.possible_legal_consequence: enforcement output is not published as reasoned judgments, so this corpus cannot observe its uptake
